<style>
/* ── 전체 래퍼 ── */
.home-wrap {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1rem;
}

/* ── 히어로 배너 ── */
.hero {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e3a2f 0%, #2e5441 60%, #3a6b52 100%);
  color: #f5f0e8;
  padding: 1.2rem 2rem;
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
}
.hero-left .hero-title {
  font-size: 1.55rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0 0 0.2rem;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
}
.hero-left .hero-title span { color: #d4a017; }
.hero-left .hero-sub {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  opacity: 0.82;
  margin: 0;
}
.hero-right .hero-motto {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-style: italic;
  border-left: 3px solid #d4a017;
  padding-left: 0.8rem;
  opacity: 0.88;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* ── 메인 2열 ── */
.main-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 300px 1fr;
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: start;
}

/* ── 왼쪽: 프로필 + 타임라인 ── */
.left-col {

}

}

}

}

}
.tl-title {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #1e3a2f;
  margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.tl-item {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
  align-items: baseline;
}
.tl-year {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #d4a017;
  min-width: 72px;
}
.tl-content {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: #555;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ── 오른쪽: 섹션 카드 ── */
.right-col {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 1rem;
}
.sec-card {
  --accent: #1e3a2f;
  --accent-soft: #e8f0ea;
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid #e8e8e8;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 1.1rem 1.15rem 1rem;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  color: inherit !important;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  transition: transform 0.22s ease, box-shadow 0.22s ease, border-color 0.22s ease;
  background: #fff;
  border-top: 3px solid var(--accent);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.sec-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(30,58,47,0.14);
  border-top-color: #d4a017;
  text-decoration: none !important;
}
.sec-card .card-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.sec-card .card-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #d4a017;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.sec-card .icon-badge {
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  min-width: 42px;
  border-radius: 11px;
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  transition: transform 0.22s ease;
}
.sec-card:hover .icon-badge { transform: scale(1.08) rotate(-2deg); }
.sec-card .card-title {
  font-size: 0.94rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #1e3a2f;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.sec-card .card-desc {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: #777;
  line-height: 1.5;
  flex-grow: 1;
}
.sec-card .card-desc .update-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 1.2em;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #0f8a7d;
  animation: pulse-badge 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes pulse-badge {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0.5; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .sec-card .card-desc .update-badge { animation: none; }
}
.sec-card .card-cta {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(-4px);
  transition: opacity 0.22s ease, transform 0.22s ease;
}
.sec-card:hover .card-cta {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateX(0);
}

/* ── 반응형 ── */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .right-col { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .hero { flex-direction: column; }
  .main-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .right-col { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
</style>
